Class PlayManager

java.lang.Object
PlayManager
public class PlayManager extends Object
Play manager class that manages the players. Uses a two dimensional array with the target position(x,y) of all of the players

      public void setupPlayStage(Play play, Team offense, Ball ball, boolean attackingRight, int stage)
